title: Great experience
text:
Very informative.
Both Anna and Nuria were super nice and explained the information very well with their great manner. Unfortunately, Nuria couldn't do anything about the rainy weather either, which is why we ended this part of the tour early. Many thanks to both—well done! PS: In case of rain, definitely make sure to wear sturdy footwear 🤣
author: Sightseer15913364902

text: Laura’s knowledge and passion of the Alhambra is infectious!  This was the second time we have visited, this tour was much more enjoyable.  I highly recommend!

title: Two top visits with Andrea
text:
We had the chance to visit the Alhambra with Andrea then 16 other people. in the afternoon we were only 3: private tour of the Albaycin and Sacromonte.
For each visit Andrea shared a lot of information without ever getting lost in too many details or dates that we would not remember. That was great!
